error.forbidden: Your account can’t change playlists yet.
error.invalid: That change doesn’t fit this playlist. Reload and try again.
error.notFound: That playlist or snapshot no longer exists.
error.hiddenItems: The playlist has local files or unavailable tracks Rewind can’t see. This change would delete them, so nothing was changed.
error.stale: The playlist changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version.
error.failed: The change didn’t go through. Nothing was changed; try again.

outcome.partialTitle: Only part of the change went through
outcome.partialItems: The playlist may hold part of the change. Nothing is lost: a snapshot from before was saved.
outcome.partialSources: The merge worked, but only {done} of {total} source playlists were deleted.
outcome.partialPlaylists: Created {done} of {total} playlists before an error. The original playlist is unchanged.
outcome.restoreFailed: Restoring didn’t work. Try again from History & undo.
outcome.undone: Undone. The previous track list is back.

create.title: New playlist

create.name: Name

merge.title: Merge playlists
merge.description: Add the tracks of one or more playlists to another one, or to a new playlist.
merge.sourcesHint: Pick one or more playlists whose tracks can be read.
merge.skipExisting: Skip tracks that are already in the target

previewError.forbidden: Your account can’t change playlists yet.
previewError.invalid: Choose at least one source playlist.
previewError.notFound: One of the playlists no longer exists.
previewError.readOnly: The tracks of one of these playlists can’t be read.
previewError.hiddenItems: A source playlist has local files or unavailable tracks. Deleting it would lose them; keep the sources or merge without deleting.
previewError.stale: The playlists changed. Reload and try again.
previewError.failed: The preview didn’t load. Try again.

merge.confirmTitle: Delete {count, plural, one {the source playlist} other {# source playlists}}?
merge.confirmBody: After merging, {names} will be deleted. Playlists you only follow are kept. A deleted playlist can’t be restored here.
merge.done: Merged {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} into this playlist.

duplicates.title: Remove duplicates

hint.exact: Only the very same track twice.
hint.recording: Same ISRC: the same recording released on different albums.
hint.titleAllArtists: Same title and the same artists. Notes like “Remastered”, “Live” or “feat.” are ignored.
hint.titleSharedArtist: Same title and at least one shared artist. Notes like “Remastered” are ignored.
hint.title: Same title only. Loose: check every group.

duplicates.emptyBody: Try a looser match to catch remasters and alternate releases.
duplicates.willRemove: {count, plural, one {# track will be removed} other {# tracks will be removed}}
duplicates.keepOldest: Keep the oldest in every group
duplicates.snapshotNote: A snapshot is saved first. You can undo this from History & undo at any time.
duplicates.done: Removed {count, plural, one {# duplicate} other {# duplicates}}.

compare.title: Compare with another playlist
compare.description: Finds songs that {name} shares with another playlist, so you can remove them from one of the two.
compare.pickBody: Tracks both playlists have show up here, with how closely they match.
compare.errorBody: The music service didn't answer. Try again in a moment.
compare.emptyTitle: No shared tracks at this strictness
compare.emptyBody: Try a looser match to catch remasters and alternate releases.
compare.readOnly: This playlist is read-only, so its tracks can't be removed.
compare.snapshotNote: A snapshot of the changed playlist is saved first. You can undo this from its History & undo.
compare.done: Removed {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} from {name}.
compare.found: {count, plural, one {# track in {name} is also in {other}} other {# tracks in {name} are also in {other}}}

split.title: Split playlist
split.minSizeHint: Groups with fewer tracks go into “Other”.
split.creates: {count, plural, one {Creates # new playlist} other {Creates # new playlists}} · the original stays as is
split.done: Created {count, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}}. Find them in Playlists.

history.title: History & undo
history.description: A snapshot is stored before every bulk change. Restoring replaces the current track list.
history.emptyBody: Bulk changes like removing duplicates or sorting save one here first.

kind.edit: {count, plural, =0 {Changed the order} one {Removed # track} other {Removed # tracks}}
kind.removeMatches: Removed {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} another playlist also has
kind.removeDuplicates: Removed {count, plural, one {# duplicate} other {# duplicates}}
kind.sort: Sorted {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}}
kind.merge: Merged in {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}}
kind.moveOut: Moved {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} to other playlists
kind.moveIn: Moved in {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}}

history.meta: {date} · {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} before
history.note: Restoring saves a snapshot too, so a restore can be undone.

sortInto.title: Sort into playlists
sortInto.description: AI suggests the best playlist for each of the {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} in {name}. You review every suggestion before anything moves.
sortInto.targetsHint: Up to {max} playlists. Their names, descriptions and a few tracks from each tell the AI what belongs where.
sortInto.noTargets: No other playlist you can change
sortInto.needTarget: You need another playlist you can change to sort into.

levelHint.strict: Only suggestions with at least 80% confidence start ticked. Fewer moves, almost no mistakes.
levelHint.balanced: Suggestions with at least 60% confidence start ticked. The rest stay in the playlist for you to decide.
levelHint.loose: Suggestions with at least 40% confidence start ticked. More moves; check the low ones.

sortInto.skipExisting: Skip tracks a playlist already has
sortInto.demoNote: Suggestions are pre-made from each track’s genre; no AI model runs.
sortInto.suggest: {count, plural, one {Suggest for # track} other {Suggest for # tracks}}
sortInto.deciding: Deciding {tracks, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} across {targets, plural, one {# playlist} other {# playlists}}…
sortInto.summary: {move, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} will move · {stay} stay where they are
sortInto.snapshotNote: A snapshot of every playlist that changes is saved first, so each one can be undone from History & undo.
sortInto.emptyTitle: No track fits any of these playlists
sortInto.emptyBody: Every suggestion was “keep it here”. Add other playlists or try a looser level.

error.forbidden: Sorting with AI isn’t enabled for your account.
error.invalid: Something in the request wasn’t valid. Close the dialog and try again.
error.notFound: One of the playlists no longer exists.
error.readOnly: One of the playlists can’t be changed or read.
error.tooLarge: This playlist is too large to sort at once (over {max} tracks).
error.notConfigured: AI sorting isn’t available here: this deployment has no access to the decision model. The other playlist tools still work.
error.timeout: The AI took too long to answer. Nothing changed; try again.
error.provider: The AI didn’t answer. Nothing changed in your playlists; try again in a moment.
error.rateLimited: You’ve used today’s AI runs. Try again tomorrow.
